disorder-name.detail: Clinical cohort of frontal glioma patients
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A final cohort of 45 patients (29 men, 16 women, age (mean ± standard deviation (SD)) = 43.2 ± 9.7 years, all right-handed) and 51  age-matched  healthy  controls  (24  men,  27  women, age = 42.6 ± 9.7 years, all right-handed) were included in the study."
